MISSION_M000_OBJECTIVE_EVACUATE: Escort the rescued civilians to the extraction point
MISSION_M000_CUE_ON_START_LINE_0: Rescue Peng Xin and Uncle Luo, then escort every survivor to the extraction point.
MISSION_M001_OBJECTIVE_RESCUE_DRIVER: Rescue the train driver, Tiedan's father
MISSION_M001_OBJECTIVE_DESTROY_BARRACKS: Destroy both targets in the enemy barracks
MISSION_M001_OBJECTIVE_BOARD_TRAIN: Have Guming escort Tiedan's father onto the train
MISSION_M002_OBJECTIVE_EVACUATE: Bring Qiangzi and Zhao to the extraction point together
MISSION_M003_OBJECTIVE_PLACE_BRIDGE_CHAR: Place explosives at the five marked positions on the railway bridge
MISSION_M003_OBJECTIVE_EVACUATE_BY_TRUCK: Get the entire squad aboard the truck and withdraw
MISSION_M004_OBJECTIVE_ELIMINATE_OFFICER: Eliminate the enemy officer carrying the battle plan
MISSION_M005_OBJECTIVE_ACQUIRE_DOCUMENT: Recover the important document carried by A-Gui
MISSION_M006_OBJECTIVE_FOLLOW_CONTACT: Shadow Sun Damazi to the meeting point
MISSION_M006_OBJECTIVE_ELIMINATE_SUN: Assassinate Sun Damazi and recover the name list
MISSION_M006_STABLE_MOD_OBJECTIVE_ACQUIR: Have Qiangzi recover Sun Damazi's name list (item 101)
MISSION_M007_OBJECTIVE_EVACUATE_EVERYONE: Evacuate the entire squad and all rescued civilians safely
MISSION_M008_OBJECTIVE_PLACE_MINE_CHARGE: Place explosives at all four fortification entrances
MISSION_M008_OBJECTIVE_USE_ELEVATOR: Evacuate Zhao and Daniu by the southeast elevator
MISSION_M009_OBJECTIVE_OBTAIN_DOCUMENTS: Recover the handover documents carried by both enemy officers
MISSION_M009_OBJECTIVE_CLEAR_STATION: Eliminate the temporary station garrison (all enemy troops in the level)
MISSION_M009_OBJECTIVE_DESTROY_TRAIN: Destroy all four targets on the munitions train
MISSION_M009_STABLE_MOD_OBJECTIVE_DESTRO: Destroy all four targets on the munitions train (original stable-Mod rule)
MISSION_M010_OBJECTIVE_CAPTURE_HIGH_GROU: Have four squad members occupy all four high points simultaneously within one hour
MISSION_M011_OBJECTIVE_DESTROY_AIRFIELD: Destroy all six aircraft, control-tower and fuel-depot targets
MISSION_M011_OBJECTIVE_EVACUATE_NORTHWES: Withdraw from the airfield to the northwest
MISSION_M011_STABLE_MOD_OBJECTIVE_DESTRO: Destroy the final airfield target (original stable-Mod rule)
MISSION_M011_STABLE_MOD_OBJECTIVE_EVACUA: Bring Zhao and Qiangzi to the final exit (original stable-Mod rule)
DIRECTION_M000_BEAT_INTRO_LINE_0: Observe the guards at the village entrance first. Find Peng Xin and Uncle Luo, then escort them out.
DIRECTION_M000_BEAT_INTRO_LINE_1: This guidance was written from the recovered mission objectives; it is not original dialogue.
DIRECTION_M000_BEAT_INTRO_TUTORIAL: Select a squad member and issue a move order on the ground. Use walking, running and crawling to manage exposure.
DIRECTION_M000_BEAT_FIRST_RESCUE_LINE_0: The first civilian is safe. Maintain the escort formation and keep looking for Uncle Luo.
DIRECTION_M000_BEAT_VICTORY_LINE_0: Everyone made it safely. Move out.
DIRECTION_M001_BEAT_INTRO_LINE_0: Get the uniform and rescue the driver first. Do not approach the train until the barracks targets are dealt with.
DIRECTION_M001_BEAT_INTRO_TUTORIAL: Open the item backpack to inspect uniforms and mission items. Relevant objectives verify mission items automatically.
DIRECTION_M001_BEAT_UNIFORM_OBTAINED_LIN: We have the uniform. Rescue the driver next and mark both barracks targets.
DIRECTION_M001_BEAT_FIRST_BLAST_LINE_0: One barracks target is destroyed. Enemy troops will converge on the blast site.
DIRECTION_M001_BEAT_VICTORY_LINE_0: The driver is aboard. Mission accomplished.
DIRECTION_M002_BEAT_INTRO_LINE_0: Study the patrols around the prison before freeing Qiangzi. The supply truck must be destroyed with explosives.
DIRECTION_M002_BEAT_INTRO_TUTORIAL: Select explosives in the item backpack and interact near the demolition marker. This mission consumes one charge.
DIRECTION_M002_BEAT_PRISONER_FREED_LINE_: I can move. Destroy the supply truck, then we leave together.
DIRECTION_M002_BEAT_VICTORY_LINE_0: We lost the pursuers. Keep withdrawing.
DIRECTION_M003_BEAT_INTRO_LINE_0: The railway bridge has five demolition points. Spread out, but keep a safe route back to the truck.
DIRECTION_M003_BEAT_INTRO_TUTORIAL: Plan the order of consecutive demolition targets from the map. Do not let squad members block one another on the narrow bridge.
DIRECTION_M003_BEAT_CHARGES_SET_LINE_0: All five charges are set. Everyone rally at the truck.
DIRECTION_M003_BEAT_VICTORY_LINE_0: The entire squad is aboard. The railway-bridge operation is complete.
DIRECTION_M004_BEAT_INTRO_LINE_0: Rescue Guming first. The designated officer carries the plan, and both granaries must also be dealt with.
DIRECTION_M004_BEAT_INTRO_TUTORIAL: Targets carrying mission items leave drops when defeated. Approach and interact to recover the battle plan.
DIRECTION_M004_BEAT_OFFICER_DOWN_LINE_0: The officer is down. Do not leave his battle plan behind.
DIRECTION_M004_BEAT_PLAN_OBTAINED_LINE_0: The plan is secured. Concentrate on the two granaries.
DIRECTION_M004_BEAT_VICTORY_LINE_0: The granaries are destroyed and we have the plan. Withdraw.
DIRECTION_M005_BEAT_INTRO_LINE_0: The traitor A-Gui appears as A-Quan in the level resources; they are the same confirmed target. After eliminating him, Zhao, Qiangzi or Guming must recover the important document.
DIRECTION_M005_BEAT_INTRO_TUTORIAL: The town has many narrow passages. Crawl and use close combat to limit alarm spread, then choose an escape route.
DIRECTION_M005_BEAT_TRAITOR_DOWN_LINE_0: The target is dealt with. Search for the document and do not linger in town.
DIRECTION_M005_BEAT_VICTORY_LINE_0: The important document is secure. The Hanjiang Town mission is complete.
DIRECTION_M006_BEAT_INTRO_LINE_0: Do not alert the target too early. Shadow Sun Damazi to the meeting point, then confirm both assassination targets.
DIRECTION_M006_BEAT_INTRO_TUTORIAL: Stay outside the target's view and control your following distance. An alarm triggers a coordinated search around the meeting area.
DIRECTION_M006_BEAT_EXCHANGE_LINE_0: The meeting point is confirmed. Sun Damazi and Kato Koichi are now valid targets.
DIRECTION_M006_BEAT_TARGETS_DOWN_LINE_0: Once the targets are confirmed, move to the exit and avoid fighting the reinforcements.
DIRECTION_M006_BEAT_VICTORY_LINE_0: The retribution operation is over. Leave the meeting area.
DIRECTION_M007_BEAT_INTRO_LINE_0: Find my parents and Miss Sun first. Once everyone is rescued, we withdraw together. We cannot take too long.
DIRECTION_M007_BEAT_INTRO_TUTORIAL: Rescued civilians follow the squad. Before withdrawing, confirm that every escort is alive and inside the exit radius.
DIRECTION_M007_BEAT_PARENTS_SAFE_LINE_0: My parents are safe. Keep looking for Miss Sun, and do not stretch the group too far.
DIRECTION_M007_BEAT_ALL_RESCUED_LINE_0: All rescue targets are accounted for. Enemy troops will try to seal the extraction point.
DIRECTION_M008_BEAT_INTRO_LINE_0: Place explosives at all four fortification entrances. Do not detonate anything before every charge is set.
DIRECTION_M008_BEAT_INTRO_TUTORIAL: Set all four charges before using manual detonation. Detonating early fails the mission immediately.
DIRECTION_M008_BEAT_CHARGES_READY_LINE_0: All four charges are in place. Manual detonation is now available.
DIRECTION_M008_BEAT_DETONATED_LINE_0: It's open! Zhao, withdraw to the southeast elevator.
DIRECTION_M008_BEAT_VICTORY_LINE_0: Zhao and Daniu have evacuated through the elevator.
DIRECTION_M009_BEAT_INTRO_LINE_0: Two officers each carry a handover document. Eliminate the garrison and deal with all four train targets.
DIRECTION_M009_BEAT_INTRO_TUTORIAL: This mission has three parallel tracks: documents, garrison and demolition. After splitting the squad, use shortcuts to switch members quickly.
DIRECTION_M009_BEAT_DOCUMENTS_LINE_0: Both handover documents are secured. Continue clearing the garrison and finish demolishing the train.
DIRECTION_M009_BEAT_STATION_CLEAR_LINE_0: The garrison is gone. Check all four train targets and do not miss a demolition point.
DIRECTION_M009_BEAT_VICTORY_LINE_0: The documents, garrison and munitions-train targets are all dealt with.
DIRECTION_M010_BEAT_INTRO_LINE_0: Zhao, Qiangzi, Daniu and Guming must occupy the four high points simultaneously; Tiedan cannot substitute for them.
DIRECTION_M010_BEAT_INTRO_TUTORIAL: Issue separate move orders to the four required members. All four zones must be occupied at once, so early arrivals must hold position.
DIRECTION_M010_BEAT_TIME_WARNING_LINE_0: Less than fifteen minutes remain. Recheck the assignment of the four squad members to the four high points.
DIRECTION_M010_BEAT_VICTORY_LINE_0: All four high points are under simultaneous control.
DIRECTION_M011_BEAT_INTRO_LINE_0: Assassinate the air commander first, confirm all six demolition targets, then withdraw to the northwest.
DIRECTION_M011_BEAT_INTRO_LINE_1: The six-target rule follows the briefing and repaired map intent instead of reproducing the original last-target pointer defect.
DIRECTION_M011_BEAT_INTRO_TUTORIAL: Use the tactical map to plan the order of the six targets and preserve the northwest escape route. After an alarm, enemy units coordinate across sectors.
DIRECTION_M011_BEAT_COMMANDER_DOWN_LINE_: The commander is eliminated. The airfield garrison is on full alert; begin demolishing each target.
DIRECTION_M011_BEAT_AIRFIELD_DESTROYED_L: All six targets are confirmed destroyed. Withdraw to the northwest.
DIRECTION_M011_BEAT_VICTORY_LINE_0: The airfield raid is complete. The entire squad is out of the combat zone.
FAILURE_REASON_PREMATURE_EXPLOSION: the charges were detonated too early
